The source text explicitly labels the theorem ex post, so the proof route treats posterior belief objects as unnecessary after history and realized values are fixed.
theorem8_continuous_generalized_english_.source_evidence: EOS07GSP.txt:528-590 and EOS07GSP.txt:800-940: Theorem 8 states that the generalized English auction has a unique perfect Bayesian equilibrium with strategies continuous in valuations: an advertiser with value s_i drops out at price p_i(k,h,s_i)=s_i-(alpha_k/alpha_{k-1})(s_i-b_{k+1}); in this equilibrium each advertiser's position and payoff coincide with VCG, and the equilibrium is ex post.
